findings.title: Modify a role's permissions and rewrite its trust
findings.message: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:user/attacker can act as effective admin of account 111111111111 using iam:AttachRolePolicy, iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy
findings.remediation: Remove the permission-management action on other principals, or deny it in a permissions boundary; also review how the caller can act as the target.

findings.title: Rewrite a role's trust policy
findings.message: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:user/attacker can act as arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/victim-role using iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy
findings.remediation: Restrict iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy to administrators, scope it to specific role ARNs, or deny it in a permissions boundary.

findings.title: Attach a policy to a role it can assume
findings.message: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:user/attacker can modify the permissions of arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/victim-role using iam:AttachRolePolicy
findings.remediation: Remove the permission-management action on other principals, or deny it in a permissions boundary; also review how the caller can act as the target.

findings.title: Create a new policy version for a role it can assume
findings.message: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:user/attacker can modify the permissions of arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/victim-role using iam:CreatePolicyVersion
findings.remediation: Remove the permission-management action on other principals, or deny it in a permissions boundary; also review how the caller can act as the target.

findings.title: Put an inline policy on a role it can assume
findings.message: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:user/attacker can modify the permissions of arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/victim-role using iam:PutRolePolicy
findings.remediation: Remove the permission-management action on other principals, or deny it in a permissions boundary; also review how the caller can act as the target.
